# Copilot Instructions

See [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root — it holds every rule,
convention, and workflow for this project, and is the single place they are
maintained. This file exists only as a thin pointer for Copilot surfaces that
look in `.github/` first.

The learning skills are available here too: say `pmexpert` for the guided
mastery path, `tutor` for a per-topic tutor, or `pm-query` to query the
analytics library in natural language. They load from `.github/skills/`,
which points at the canonical packages under `skills/`.
